title: CAMGen: A Core Change-Aware Multi-View Framework for Commit Message Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Commit messages help developers understand code changes and support software maintenance. Recent approaches use repository context to improve commit message generation (CMG) with large language models (LLMs). However, existing CMG methods provide limited support for understanding how local edits affect functionality jointly implemented by multiple code entities. This functional understanding is essential for generating commit messages that explain the main change and its impact. To address this problem, we propose CAMGen, a core change-aware multi-view commit message generation framework that incorporates functional context into generation. CAMGen identifies core entities that represent the primary change intent. It then forms candidate functional units through repository-wide semantic clustering and uses those containing the core entities to construct a Functional Semantic View. translated_title: CAMGen：一种核心变更感知的多视图提交信息生成框架
translated_abstract: 提交信息帮助开发者理解代码变更并支持软件维护。近期的方法利用仓库上下文来改进基于大语言模型（LLM）的提交信息生成（CMG）。然而，现有的CMG方法对于理解局部编辑如何影响由多个代码实体共同实现的功能方面提供的支持有限。这种功能层面的理解对于生成能够解释主要变更及其影响的提交信息至关重要。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CAMGen，一个核心变更感知的多视图提交信息生成框架，它将功能上下文融入到生成过程中。CAMGen首先识别代表主要变更意图的核心实体；然后通过仓库范围的语义聚类形成候选功能单元，并利用包含核心实体的单元构建功能语义视图。该视图为解释变更提供了语义上下文……
tldr: CAMGen通过识别代表主要变更意图的核心实体，并借助仓库级语义聚类构建功能语义视图，将多代码实体协作实现的功能上下文融入提交信息生成，从而生成更能准确解释变更及其影响的提交信息。
en_tdlr: CAMGen is a core change-aware multi-view framework that identifies core entities representing the primary change intent and constructs a Functional Semantic View through repository-wide semantic clustering, incorporating functional context to generate commit messages that better explain changes and their impact.
